content.coverageNote: Complete captions include the open discussion, full audience-question segment and both guests’ farewells through 1:50:08. The remaining recording contains music and host-only conference announcements, channel promotion and audience chat; both opponents have left. The sole gap above 12 seconds occurs in that outro while the host handles podcast links. Final captions display 1.319 seconds beyond player duration. No substantive debate turn is excluded.
content.captionCaution: Recognition errors in names, technical terms, negation, biblical chapter ranges and citations are not participant errors. Exact text and timestamps remain unchanged. Materially unresolved attribution or load-bearing wording requires verification before assessment.

participants.questionHandling: The moderator introduces and redirects the topic, manages transitions and reads or clarifies audience questions. Those question premises are context, not adopted primary-speaker claims. Only Rauser and Aron Ra develop sustained opposing cases. Both answers and counter-responses are eligible.
